confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge; no city-price searches, live booking pages or current listings were consulted. Beer and restaurant anchors are moderately reliable. Cocktail and wine_glass were set at roughly 2 to 2.2 times the draught beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. Accommodation is least certain because rates vary by beach area, property and booking lead time; July falls outside the December to March peak. midrange_meal_2p has a wide plausible range by venue. USD values depend on the baht rate, which was not verified for July 2026.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against other Thai island resort towns, such as the beach areas of Phuket, Ao Nang in Krabi and Koh Phangan, with a modest island premium over mainland Thai towns for imported drinks, beachfront lodging and tourist-area restaurants.
